_doc: Single source of truth for the anime proportions of Clara and Davi (build_vroid.py and measure_vrm.py check against it, tolerance tol). Only pixel measurements taken by eye in the browser from the official MiSide Steam store media are recorded here; no image of the game is stored in the project.

sources.body: Steam store screenshot ss_b65b0017 (1920x1080): heroine walking, side-on, camera roughly at chest height. Head bowed over a phone, legs mid-stride.
sources.face: Steam store library_600x900 key art: heroine face, slight 3/4 turn.

notes: height = head top to mean ground of the two soles (708 px), +4% for the stride: 736 px; head = 129 px -> 5.7 heads raw. The bob/bun hair volume is counted in the head (VRoid measures the same way: crown of the hair mesh to chin), so the target is rounded to 6.0.
inseam = crotch to front sole 310 px over 748 px = 0.414; legs are ~20 deg off vertical mid-stride (cos = 0.94) -> 0.44; rounded to 0.45.
eye width = mean of near and far eye (3/4 view) over face width at the eye line: 74 / 260 = 0.285.
eye height over head height (hair crown to chin): 42 / 463 = 0.091. Eye aspect h/w on the near eye: 0.5.
eye line = eye centre height above the chin over head height: 155 / 463 = 0.335.
Mita's in-game model was measured by a modder at ~1.78 m ('tall and slender'); Clara is set to 1.70 m and Davi to 1.80 m, keeping the same ratios.
davi_note: Davi has no direct reference in the store media (no male lead shown full body); his targets are Clara's measured values shifted toward an adult male: +0.3 heads, slightly longer legs, eyes ~12% narrower and ~18% shorter.
